title: 'The model is not supported when using Codex with a ChatGPT account' after a model retirement
symptoms: The 'gpt-5.6-sol' model is not supported when using Codex with a ChatGPT account.
The same pattern names whichever model is retired or unavailable to the plan, for example 'gpt-5.3-codex-spark'
Saved config, custom agents, or codex exec --model scripts break on a retirement date
The same model keeps working for sessions signed in with an API key
cause: Codex with ChatGPT sign-in serves only the models the plan currently includes, and retires models on fixed dates: gpt-5.4 and gpt-5.4-mini on 2026-08-31, gpt-5.3-codex-spark on 2026-09-14, and gpt-5.5 on 2026-10-14. API-key sessions follow the API model catalog instead.
fix: Replace retired model ids in config.toml, profiles, custom agents, scheduled tasks, and scripts with a model available to your plan, and check that the subscription is active.
affected: Codex with ChatGPT sign-in, retirements 2026-08-31, 2026-09-14, and 2026-10-14
